reason: The only caller that passes date overrides to getSlots is getSchedule (packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/slots.ts:410-415), and it always sets `timeZone: availability.timeZone`. That value is always a string: getUserAvailability.ts:201 resolves it as `schedule?.timeZone || eventType?.timeZone || user.timeZone`, and the overrides spread after it carry only start and end (lines 215-224), so they cannot clear it. The TeamAvailabilityTimes callers pass no dateOverrides, so the `tz(undefined)` path at packages/lib/slots.ts:44 is never reached; only the optional type leaves it open.
